slice: Legacy DWG BLOCK_RECORD XREF index retention
problem: The AC1012-AC1018 BLOCK_RECORD parser consumed xrefindex+1 but discarded it; its diagnostic cast to int16_t also misrepresented high-bit unsigned values.

spec_evidence.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.52, pp. 164-165
spec_evidence.contract: The pre-R2007 BLOCK_HEADER body carries a BS xrefindex+1 field separately from XREF reference/dependent flags. The encoded zero value represents no index; later versions have a different resolved-state body field.

changes: Retain the decoded zero-based index on DRW_Block_Record; use -1 when encoded as zero or when the version has no legacy index field.
Remove the signed 16-bit diagnostic conversion so values above INT16_MAX remain unsigned and intact.
Generate AC1015/AC1018 BLOCK_RECORD wire data in memory and parse XREF flags, overlay state, path, and typed-link alignment through the production parser.
implementation.publicApiChange: Additive DRW_Block_Record data member; the class layout changes and downstream binaries must be rebuilt. No DRW_Interface virtual or existing dwgRW::defineBlock overload changed.
implementation.fixture_or_registration: No DWG/DXF fixture file was added; one fast generated-data CTest registration was added.

generatedCases: Encoded xrefindex+1 zero maps to the absent-index sentinel -1.
Encoded value 42 maps to semantic index 41.
Encoded value 32769 maps to semantic index 32768 without signed-short truncation.
Non-overlay and overlaid XREFs retain dependent/loaded flags and the relative path remains aligned with typed block links.
regression.expected: The parser retains the index and existing flags/path/links without opening or resolving the external drawing.

diff_check.command: git diff --check -- CMakeLists.txt src/drw_objects.h src/drw_objects.cpp tests/dwg_reader_matrix_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md

fixture_policy: The test constructs generated AC1015 and AC1018 bitstreams in memory; no downloaded, customer-provided, or newly committed DWG/DXF fixture is used.
evidence_ceiling: Local parser/model retention only. DWG XREF writing, DXF-origin metadata composition, external-file availability, independent peer semantics, and native CAD acceptance remain unqualified; this slice promotes no support claim.
next_unresolved: Add a non-pure XREF metadata submission route, then implement the versioned BLOCK_HEADER writer vectors and verify them with an independent bit walker plus the production reader.
repository_state: Broadly dirty shared worktree; only the local XREF-index parser/model slice, its generated focused test, plan progress, and receipt were changed for this slice. Nothing was staged or committed.
